comment: Pinned identities of the upstream KernelSU release assets that
build/scripts/patch-android-boot-ksu.py installs into the stock Android ramdisk.
These are checksums of a published upstream release, not secrets.  The
assets themselves are an upstream input and are not redistributed here;
build/scripts/fetch-kernelsu-assets.sh downloads them into a local cache and
refuses anything whose sha256 is not the one recorded below.
'kmi' is the Generic Kernel Image module interface the LKM is built for.
The stock liuqin Android kernel reports 5.10.209-android12-9, i.e. KMI
android12-5.10, so that is the only LKM this project pins.
